correctness.rationale: The two digit-difference coordinates map injectively to distinct positive outputs modulo the base. Exact permutation multiplicities for three equality regimes exhaust every input, and optimized quadratic products give the maximum. A Riemann sum on a triangle and exact elementary integral yield the limiting upper tail. Complete independent direct enumeration confirms all bases 2..22; finite checks support but do not replace the all-base proof.
